requirements.statement: A CI job that fails and then passes on rerun is filed as a follow-up through file-followups the first time any feature sees it flake, and is never filed a second time
requirements.source: TRD Objectives table, row O1 (must pass: yes)

requirements.statement: Once a job has flaked 3 times (counted across every feature), a pass on rerun no longer counts: wait-ci returns failed for it
requirements.source: TRD Objectives table, row O2 (must pass: yes)

requirements.statement: Flake history is written only under .trd-state/<feature>/ and counted by reading every feature's history; no shared mutable file is added
requirements.source: TRD Objectives table, row O3 (must pass: yes)

requirements.statement: Jest: one rerun-pass then import yields exactly one flaky:<job> row; a second flake (same or another feature) then import yields none
Jest: the third flake of a job across two feature directories returns capped: true
After these runs the only files written are .trd-state/<feature>/flaky.jsonl and .trd-state/<feature>/discovered.jsonl

npx jest packages/core/lib/flaky-ci.test.js passes; same run id recorded twice counts once; _-prefixed dirs are not counted; .claude/lib/flaky-ci.js is byte-identical to the core file and packages/full/lib/flaky-ci.js is a symlink to it
requirements.source: TRD Master Task List, FIX-001 acceptance criteria

requirements.statement: npx jest packages/core/contracts/ship-primitives.test.js passes with new assertions: wait-ci names flaky-ci.js record, the cap of 3, capped and --json jobs; file-followups names flaky-ci.js import and flaky:<job>; collect-findings names capped: true, [flaky-capped] and returns stop; .claude/contracts stays identical to the core files
requirements.source: TRD Master Task List, FIX-002 acceptance criteria

tasks.description: Add flaky-ci.js library + CLI (record, import, count) with Jest tests; vendor it to .claude/lib/ and link it from packages/full/lib/. Depends on: none. Serves O1, O2, O3.

Wire the library into ship-primitive-wait-ci.md (step 3 + Result, job name from gh run view --json jobs), ship-primitive-file-followups.md (step 1 third source, step 5 list) and ship-primitive-collect-findings.md (capped: true recorded as [flaky-capped], not judged, returns stop); mirror all three to .claude/contracts/; add contract assertions to ship-primitives.test.js. Depends on: FIX-001. Serves O1, O2.

could_not_verify: A real GitHub Actions rerun-pass: wait-ci's prose drives gh, and no live CI is exercised here; the library is proven by Jest only.

A flake recorded by wait-ci after a merge (context.merged) is written to the state directory but /ship-build does not commit the record of a merged branch, so that flake is counted only on the machine that saw it.
Two features that see a job's first flake on parallel branches can each file it before either ledger reaches the other; once-per-job holds across the history each branch can read.
